tony: FYI I raised a docs PR to add a tiny "Provisioning quick tip" section for Dedicated reserved pools. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5128

ren: can we include a JavaScript/Node snippet? Our SDK users keep asking for direct copy/paste examples.

tonv: sure, sketching one. also adding a short migration note: if you're moving from old `pool_size` fields, map to `min_replicas`/`max_replicas`.

tonv: ```js
const { Dedicated } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Dedicated({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await client.createReservedPool({
  tenantId: 'acme-123',
  gpuType: 'a100-40gb',
  min_replicas: 2,
  max_replicas: 6,
  isolation: 'tenant_level',
  autoscale: { cooldown_seconds: 180, scale_up_threshold: 0.7 }
});
```

claire: tiny wording nit: instead of "best-effort warm start" please use: "Warm starts are attempted when capacity exists; cold starts may add extra latency." More precise for support.

tony: changed. added an HCL snippet and a short troubleshooting bullet about tenant labels mismatches.

claire: CI flaky earlier, running docs-bot check now.

docs-bot: docs CI triggered -> https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/44102. lint OK, linkcheck fixed.

ren: lgtm after the JS rename to `min_replicas` casing. I'll merge and backport the migration note to the handbook page.

tonv: added changelog line under dedicated release notes: "added quick JS example, migration mapping, and provisioning troubleshooting note". will ping #announcements when merged. :bell:
